name: The Home Depot Pro Xtra Credit Card

localized_names.en: The Home Depot Pro Xtra Credit Card

apr.notes: Pricing as of 4/1/24: minimum finance charge $1; late fee up to $40. APR is in the card agreement and not shown on the product page.

base_rate.description: Every $1 spent on qualifying purchases with the card counts as $4 toward earning Pro Xtra Perks.

rewards.redemption_notes: Perks are earned at spend thresholds starting at $2,500 in qualifying purchases, up to $1,000,000 spent per program period.

notes: Business store card for Home Depot Pro Xtra members, issued by Citi; usable only at The Home Depot, so network is other. The product page states annual fee: None.
